sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE VI OF 2002
BALOCHISTAN
PROVINCE REMOVAL FROM SERVICE
(SPECIAL POWERS)
(AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE 2002
ORDINANCE VI OF 2002
An Ordinance
further to amend the Balochistan Province Removal from Service (Special Powers)
Ordinance, 2000
[Gazette of
Balochistan, Extraordinary, 16th March, 2002]
No. Legis. 1-119/Law/2002,
dated 16-3-2002.--The following Ordinance made by the Governor of
Balochistan on 6th March; 2002, is hereby published for general information:--
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called the Balochistan Province
Removal from Service (Special Powers) (Amendment) Ordinance, 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

ORDINANCE VI OF 2002
An Ordinance
further to amend the Balochistan Province Removal from Service (Special Powers)
Ordinance, 2000
[Gazette of
Balochistan, Extraordinary, 16th March, 2002]
No. Legis. 1-119/Law/2002,
dated 16-3-2002.--The following Ordinance made by the Governor of
Balochistan on 6th March; 2002, is hereby published for general information:--
2. Insertion of new sections
14-A and 14-B, Ordinance III of 2000.---In the Balochistan Province Removal
from Service (Special Powers) Ordinance, 2000, after section 14, the following
new section shall be inserted, namely:--
"14A. Indemnity.--No
suit, prosecution or other legal proceedings shall lie against the competent
authority or an officer or authority authorized by it for anything which is in
good faith done or intended to be done under this Ordinance or, the rules,
instructions or directions made or issued thereunder.
14B. Jurisdiction barred.--Save
.as provided under this Ordinance no order made or proceedings taken under this
Ordinance, or the rules made thereunder by the competent authority or any
officer or authority authorized by it shall be called in question in any Court
and no injunction shall be granted by any Court in respect of any decision made
or proceedings taken in pursuance of any power conferred by or under this
Ordinance, or the rules made thereunder.
